scope: Eight two-sensor real Radiance coupling and uniform-normalization fixtures; not full-grid, annual accuracy, qualified references or an accepted profile.
concurrency: Observed under concurrent reference and other numerical verification, up to eight heavy one-worker processes; elapsed times are not isolated benchmarks.

declaration.scope: Coupling and per-bin positivity only; secondary sampling is not an accuracy profile
declaration.depth_accounting: Radiance radiance-response primaries replace one I+ hemispherical bounce; full ab7/8 corresponds in maximum diffuse depth to I+ ab8/9
declaration.primary_rule: Continuous Hammersley sensor-major stream: r=sqrt((i+0.5)/N), phi=2*pi*base2_radical_inverse(i), z=sqrt(1-r*r); i=0..N-1; no scramble/rotation; origin=sensor+1e-4 up; identical full/direct bytes
checks: Every full-minus-direct coefficient is finite and nonnegative without clamping
Black opaque room retains glass; every full-minus-direct coefficient is exactly zero
Unobstructed uniform full and direct irradiance agree with pi*L within1%
Fixed A and B two-sensor RGB coefficient shapes and direct pairing
